title: Fjordbound
brief: Gather timber and provisions, recover raid caches and defend a fjord settlement before the longship departs.
players: 1–4 LAN cooperative players; local solo campaign

chapters.title: The Broken Longship
chapters.story: Astrid returns to a broken longship and a settlement waiting for winter.

chapters.title: Stormward Shore
chapters.story: Eirik needs timber and the stores lost on the stormward shore, where raiders now camp.

chapters.title: Oath of the Fjord
chapters.story: Liv calls the clan to keep its oath: defend the homes before chasing glory across the fjord.

status: development; build, gameplay, physical controller, multi-machine LAN and Steam release acceptance tracked separately
inspiration: Original characters, names, story and code; genre references are design inspiration only.
